title: Not sure about these rugs
text:
Not sure about these rugs. These rugs are very different than anything else I have had for bathroom rugs. The memory foam almost completely compresses when I step on it. That has two effects. I have minimal cushioning and my feet/shoes sink into 1/2-inch depressions. I think my old normal rugs gave better cushioning. They certainly did not have nearly as much of an impression. The impression persists for several seconds, so if you move your feet, there is a very uneven feel to the rug surface.

It is hard to describe the feel of these rugs, but they tend to be at the extremes for good and bad in my opinion.
I cannot speak to quality and durability, but the tag claims you can machine wash the rugs. I take that with a big grain of salt becasue I ahve yet to see other memory foam products that make that claim, and most explicitly state dry clean only or not to machine wash at home.
